title: Preparation of fluorescent beads under C. elegans for fluorescence microscopy with adaptive optics
protocol: Dilute the original 100-nm fluorescent bead solution by a factor of 100 (v/v) with distilled water.
Mix the diluted bead solution with the Vortex Mixer.
Drop 10 μL of the diluted bead solution on a charged slide.
Let the dropped solution dry for 10 minutes on a hot plate set to 35°C.
Place a wild-type C. elegans adult hermaphrodite on a clean coverslip with 10 μL of a 50 mM phosphatase inhibitor Tetramisole hydrochloride solution.
Drop 10 μL of glycerol on the slide prepared in step 2 before the Tetramisole solution dries completely.
Mount the coverslip prepared in step 3 onto the slide prepared in step 1 quickly and fix it carefully using nail polish.
